cases.stimulus: BUILD?; CAPS?; SELFTEST
cases.oracle: exact manifest buildId, version, supported limits, PASS primitive checks

cases.stimulus: PING with CR/LF/CRLF; ECHO with leading/trailing spaces; RUN TEXT token
cases.oracle: all expected bytes exactly, including spaces/endings

cases.stimulus: RUN UTF8 token; RUN CP949 token; SPLIT 30 multibyte-text
cases.oracle: independent standard encoding bytes and CRC; GUI decode checked separately with chosen encoding
sideEffects: manual encoding change if validating CP949 display

cases.area: binary / NUL / control bytes / multi-byte LEN
cases.stimulus: RUN BYTES token; RUN CONTROL token; binary ECHO at 0/1/255/256/257/511/512/513/1023/1024 bytes; reject 1025; split LEN header; coalesce 1KiB frames
cases.oracle: all bytes, high LEN bits/endian, CRC, no truncation/block reordering; exact NUL/TAB/backspace; correct oversize/CRC rejection

cases.stimulus: RUN NEWLINES token; LONG 2048; SPLIT; combined commands/frames
cases.oracle: byte stream unchanged across chunks, CR/LF interpretation per configured parser

cases.stimulus: DELAY 1500 token; SILENT; SPLIT 20 token
cases.oracle: no premature data; full late reply; expected miss has no automatic retransmission

cases.stimulus: oversized/control command; bad binary CRC/LEN; unknown command
cases.oracle: documented ERR, next valid PING succeeds; intentional errors separate from UART losses

cases.stimulus: FAULT DROP 5; FAULT DUP 3; BURST 30; FAULT CRC 7; HEX 21; FAULT CLEAR
cases.oracle: exact expected missing/duplicate/corrupt positions, no other loss
sideEffects: explicit fault injection until FAULT CLEAR or reset

cases.stimulus: BURST 1000 32; HEX 1000; command during STREAM; STOP
cases.oracle: exact count/order/payload, bounded device buffers, zero unplanned drops/errors, generator can be stopped

cases.stimulus: RUN EVENTS token; LEVELS
cases.oracle: WARN/ERROR rule counts and before/after context match fixture; tray notification inspected
cases.validator: FixtureContractCheck for bytes; GUI manual for behavior

cases.stimulus: repeat RUN TEXT/EVENTS/JSON with unique tokens
cases.oracle: exact expected matching rows, hidden rows still retained, navigation lands on expected record
cases.validator: GUI manual plus raw fixture evidence

cases.stimulus: RUN ANSI/CONTROL/BYTES token; select and copy
cases.oracle: raw bytes proven independently; colors, HEX selection length and clipboard checked in UI
sideEffects: explicit display mode changes clear visible history; do not switch implicitly

cases.stimulus: operator enables LOG; BURST count padding; run known fixtures
cases.oracle: compare every rotated/exported file with expected RX, no missing/duplicate records; disk error surfaced
cases.validator: manual log setup and offline file comparison
sideEffects: disk writes; rotation; optional controlled destination failure

cases.stimulus: STREAM START 10; pause/resume; observe before/after retention limit
cases.oracle: stable memory envelope, bounded retained rows, full disk capture continues, no crash/drop
cases.validator: timed hardware run plus GUI/process metrics

cases.area: saved commands / GUI / CLI / MCP sequences
cases.stimulus: smoke.cli.json; binary.cli.json; GUI v3 checked/unchecked/disabled steps
cases.oracle: ordered one-time TX, match/miss, stop/pause/resume, preserved evidence; no RX pattern transmitted
sideEffects: named profile definitions when explicitly registered

cases.stimulus: actual plugin manifest -> SDK MCP tools -> GUI; text/hex requests; read every page
cases.oracle: real tool schemas, correct instance/port, complete offsets/lengths, invalid input rejected before TX

cases.stimulus: BAUD rate ACK; host configure; wait; PING; byte timeout 1/40/120
cases.oracle: new rate confirmed on both sides, full frames CRC valid independently of grouping
sideEffects: baud changes; optional GUI mode changes

cases.stimulus: RESET CONFIRM
cases.oracle: old ACK drains, BOOT at 115200, next PING succeeds; do not equate target reset with USB removal

cases.stimulus: operator physically unplugs/replugs USB
cases.oracle: COM disappears/returns, fault exposed, no stale RX across connection generation, correct recovery

cases.stimulus: known fixtures on distinct targets; independent settings and shared profile save/load
cases.oracle: no cross-instance logs/commands; correct conflict handling and saved definitions
cases.validator: app unit tests plus GUI integration
sideEffects: explicit profile edits; additional target or MOCK needed

cases.stimulus: forward known byte/sequence fixtures through configured virtual pair
cases.oracle: byte-exact two-way forwarding, bounded queues, correct idle gaps and shutdown
cases.validator: additional virtual port setup and integration tests

cases.area: physical UART parity / RTS CTS / RS-485 / noise
cases.stimulus: external adapter/fixture with controlled line conditions
cases.oracle: measured electrical behavior and correct transport errors
